svg.title: kI, the grudge: a small error that won't go away
svg.desc: Animated, drawn left to right. Top, a close-up near the target: the measured position is stuck a little short of the dashed target line, the last degree, and stays there. The error between them is shaded purple as it is added up over time. Below, the I push, kI times that running total, keeps climbing for as long as the error remains, until it is big enough to close the last degree. Once the error is gone the total stops growing, so the I push holds steady. Footer: WPILib's advice is that integral gain is generally not recommended for FRC; if you use it, keep it tiny and use an IZone.
svg.text: kI, the grudge: a small error that won't go away
Push = kI × error added up over time: it grows while any error remains.
I push = kI × the error added up
A small error that never goes away eventually gets a big push.
WPILib: integral gain is generally not recommended for FRC.
If you use it, keep it tiny and use an IZone.
